intro.title: A layer between your municipality and public funding opportunities.
intro.description: Capta connects your municipality's context to opportunities published through official sources. Each public notice arrives organized, traceable, and accompanied by the factors your team needs to make an informed decision.

discovery.title: The search should not have to start from scratch.
discovery.description: Public notices and calls for proposals appear across different portals, each with its own format, rules, and deadlines. Capta starts with Transferegov.br and turns every opportunity into organized, traceable information.

analysis.title: Not every opportunity deserves the same attention.
analysis.description: Capta compares subject, deadline, and requirements with the municipality's profile, priorities, and needs. Each recommendation shows the factors behind the match without obscuring the source data.

decision.title: Your team decides. Capta shows where to start.
decision.description: Each opportunity enters an explainable action queue. The municipality can validate, dismiss, or track it while alerts keep deadlines visible.

diagram.accessibleDescription: Diagram of Capta's flow: the municipality's context guides Capta Intelligence and the organization provided by Capta Notices. The platform starts with Transferegov.br and plans to expand coverage to other official sources, connecting the team to the public funding ecosystem.
